title: fr.camera.stream_start arguments
description: Starts a stream of JPEG frames (design camera-c1 D8): to the hub over HTTP (an mjpg1 POST to /v1/stream/in/<stream_id>), to the card (a recording named by the stream id), or both. Dispatch never blocks: OK once the fr_stream task has it, BUSY while another runs, INVALID_ARGS for `to` sd or both with no card mounted, or a frame_size above the trait max_frame_size. interval_ms paces by each frame's start time (0: as fast as the sensor and the path allow); seconds and max_frames end it done (0: no limit, until stream_stop).

stream_id.description: issued by the hub; the POST path and the recording's directory name it

interval_ms.description: time between frame starts; 0: as fast as the path allows (a live view) (ms)

max_frames.description: frames to take; 0: no limit. 1 is a snapshot

frame_size.description: absent: the current frame_size (config, or the last set); for this stream only

quality.description: absent: the current quality; for this stream only (4..63)
